headline: Falcons guitars maintain tradition for over seven decades
content: Today, one would think... In family, the Henries (father and grandson) have continued with the tradition. Falcons always defends material sincerity, assures the son. The grandfather says theres nothing more valuable than what makes something happen. If someone does not know how to make something well, let another try next time who knows better. This was shared by his grandchild, who dreams of reaching Falcons’ hundred years... We should expand our market but never lose essence, specifies. Note, Falcon guitars are sold exclusively through stores owned by their producers.

headline: The secret behind successful Falcon guitars lies within its energy transmission
content: Each guitar takes between thirty to forty days using approved materials, up to two months otherwise, explains Jorge Vega, guitarist of Eva Ayllún! Made by artisans, these pieces are unique. Perhaps the key to success is transmitting the maker’s energy. Don Abraham states, Falcon guitars are made with hands, head, and heart. Building a guitar involves meticulous craftsmanship where each component contributes uniquely to sound quality. Comparisons reveal even identical woods yield different sounds due to individual crafting nuances. According to Don Abraham, like children, every guitar has distinct characteristics. Today, Falcon represents Peru globally, crafted by master builders sharing techniques widely across workshops – truly commendable!

headline: MADRUREXIT, LA CARTA DEMÓCRÁTICA DE LA OEA
content: En estos días hubo noticias monumentales. El Brexit dominó titulares mientras temas importantes como la paz colombiana y el Madurexit (el salida de Maduro), junto con la revisión de la Carta Democrática de la OEA, recibían menos atención. Esta columna está interesada principalmente en Latinoamérica y luego en países centrales, dado que afectará indirectamente nuestras realidades locales. Sin embargo, urge que nuestros gobiernos respalden la Carta Democrática frente a Maduro.

headline: EE.UU.-VENEZUELA DENUNCIA A ALMAGRO DE GOLPISTA
content: WASHINTONG (AFP).– Miembros de la Organización de Estados Americanos continúan debatiendo si aplicarán la Carta Democrática a Venezuela, tras haber pasado otra sesión sin llegar a conclusiones definitivas. Simultáneamente, el estado neozelandés critica al Secretario General de la OEA, Luis Almagro, por impulsar acciones consideradas golpes políticos contra Nicolás Maduro, utilizando instrumentos legales sin autorización previa.

headline: Serivicio es ilegal
